title: Use vector to Store and Print Integers
description: Read N integers, store in a vector, and print them.
constraints: Use std::vector. Read N, then N integers, print them.
explanation: The vector elements are printed in order.

title: Sort a Vector
description: Sort a vector of integers and print the sorted values.
constraints: Use std::vector and std::sort. Read N then N numbers. Print sorted values.
explanation: The vector is sorted and printed.

title: Use map to Count Frequencies
description: Count the frequency of integers using std::map.
constraints: Use std::map. Read N then N numbers. Print each number and its frequency.

title: Set Unique Elements
description: Use std::set to print unique integers from input.
constraints: Read N, then N integers. Use std::set to store and print them.
explanation: Unique elements printed in sorted order.

title: Priority Queue (Max Heap)
description: Use std::priority_queue to print numbers in descending order.
constraints: Use std::priority_queue. Read N, then N integers. Print in descending order.
explanation: Numbers printed from largest to smallest.

title: Custom Comparator for Sorting Pairs
description: Sort a vector of pairs using a custom comparator.
constraints: Read N, then N pairs. Sort by second then first element.
explanation: Pairs are sorted by second value, then first.

title: Student Records with Map
description: Store and print student names and grades using std::map.
constraints: Read N, then N name-grade pairs. Print all records sorted by name.
explanation: Records are printed in alphabetical order.
